findings.summary: Pinned f2c and RDTEXT need a defined disconnected-unit sentinel, initialized status handling and accurate saved-index invalidation across failed switches or closes. Native inquiry uses the ABI of its platform archive.
findings.repair: Hash-check and stage the three minimal N0067 definitions. Read through canonical RDTEXT, capture the actual unit under the toolkit lock and release its last lease. Locked independent successful reads establish a connected witness before original RDTEXT, preserving the exact original cursor and bytes.

findings.summary: The locked Python wrapper omits the setter and declares the native argv parameter as a single char pointer. Its state can be initialized only once per process.
findings.repair: Declare the independent locked C char** ABI in a separate library handle. Observe all stored bytes after overwriting caller buffers. Isolate each native setter scenario in its own process.
